headline: Visayas and Mindanao Grids Placed Under Extended Red Alerts
seoTitle: Visayas, Mindanao Red Alerts September 3 | FMB News
seoDescription: NGCP placed the Visayas and Mindanao grids under lengthy red-alert periods on September 3 as plant outages and derated units tightened supply.
deck: The Visayas grid faced a nine-hour red alert while Mindanao was also under red alert for much of the day as available capacity remained tight.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: NGCP placed both the Visayas and Mindanao grids under red alert on September 3 because available capacity and operating reserves were insufficient for demand and contingency requirements.
The Visayas red alert was scheduled from 1 p.m. to 10 p.m., while Mindanao was under red alert from noon to 9 p.m.

sections.heading: Visayas supply
paragraphs: Available capacity in the Visayas was about 2,187 MW against projected peak demand of 2,575 MW. NGCP cited forced outages, long-term unavailable units and derated plants, with total capacity losses reported at about 792 MW.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: A red alert signals that supply cannot meet consumer demand plus the grid's regulating requirements, increasing the risk of power interruptions if conditions deteriorate.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Consumers and businesses should monitor NGCP and local distribution-utility advisories for changes in alert periods and supply restoration.
